assessments_score_needs_provider.name: assessments_score_needs_provider
assessments_score_needs_provider.value: "learning_app"."assessments"."score" is null or ("learning_app"."assessments"."provider" is not null and "learning_app"."assessments"."score_scale" is not null)

assignments_test_goals.name: assignments_test_goals
assignments_test_goals.value: "learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals" is null or (cardinality("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals") between 1 and 3 and "learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals" <@ array['recall','spelling','listening','lesson']::text[] and cardinality(array_positions("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", 'recall')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", 'spelling')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", 'listening')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", 'lesson')) <= 1 and array_position("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", null) is null and (array_position("learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals", 'lesson') is null or "learning_app"."assignments"."test_goals" = array['lesson']::text[]))

generation_runs_kind_shape.name: generation_runs_kind_shape
generation_runs_kind_shape.value: ("learning_app"."generation_runs"."kind" in ('deck', 'lesson') and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."deck_version_id" is not null and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."expected_edit_number" is not null and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."asset_id" is null) or ("learning_app"."generation_runs"."kind" in ('tts', 'illustration') and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."asset_id" is not null and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."deck_version_id" is null and "learning_app"."generation_runs"."expected_edit_number" is null)

learning_sessions_mode_plan.name: learning_sessions_mode_plan
learning_sessions_mode_plan.value: ("learning_app"."learning_sessions"."mode" = 'training' and "learning_app"."learning_sessions"."mock_test_plan" is null) or ("learning_app"."learning_sessions"."mode" = 'mock_test' and "learning_app"."learning_sessions"."mock_test_plan" is not null)

media_assets_ready_complete.name: media_assets_ready_complete
media_assets_ready_complete.value: "learning_app"."media_assets"."state" <> 'ready' or ("learning_app"."media_assets"."storage_key" is not null and "learning_app"."media_assets"."mime_type" is not null and "learning_app"."media_assets"."byte_count" is not null and "learning_app"."media_assets"."content_sha256" is not null and "learning_app"."media_assets"."lease_token" is null)
